verdict.rationale: AiPrise documents native iOS and Android SDKs 'optimized for mobile capture' and an embeddable hosted web verification flow, so the multi-platform SDK half of the story is directly covered. Nothing in the evidence describes guided capture coaching such as real-time glare, blur, or edge detection. missing for 10: documented glare/blur/edge-detection coaching during capture, evidence of first-try capture quality, explicit web SDK capture details, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I get native iOS, Android, and web SDKs with guided camera capture — glare, blur, and edge detection coaching the user to a usable document photo on the first try

citations.quote: Integrate verification into iOS and Android apps with native SDKs optimized for mobile capture and performance
Embed user or business verification directly in your web applications with a fully hosted, customizable flow
